mcp-tool.name: hello
mcp-tool.label: Hello World (app script)
mcp-tool.description: Returns a hello world greeting — powered by a Shopware app script (Twig), no external server required

mcp-tool.name: ping
mcp-tool.label: Ping (app script)
mcp-tool.description: Returns a pong response with an optional message echo — powered by a Shopware app script (Twig)

mcp-tool.name: product-count
mcp-tool.label: Product Count (app script)
mcp-tool.description: DEMO ONLY — example of DAL access from a Shopware app script (Twig). Returns the total number of active products. For production use, prefer shopware-entity-aggregate with a count aggregation instead.

mcp-tool.name: hello-webhook
mcp-tool.label: Hello World (Node.js webhook)
mcp-tool.description: Returns a hello world greeting — proxied to an external Node.js webhook server via HMAC-signed HTTP POST

mcp-tool.name: ping-webhook
mcp-tool.label: Ping (Node.js webhook)
mcp-tool.description: Returns a pong response — proxied to an external Node.js webhook server via HMAC-signed HTTP POST

mcp-prompt.name: greeting-context
mcp-prompt.label: Greeting Context (Node.js webhook)
mcp-prompt.description: Provides context about how to greet users with the McpHelloWorld app

mcp-prompt.name: usage-guide
mcp-prompt.label: Usage Guide (Node.js webhook)
mcp-prompt.description: Step-by-step guide for using the McpHelloWorld MCP tools

mcp-resource.name: hello-world-status
mcp-resource.label: Hello World Status (Node.js webhook)
mcp-resource.description: Current status and configuration of the McpHelloWorld app

mcp-resource.name: hello-world-stats
mcp-resource.label: Hello World Stats (Node.js webhook)
mcp-resource.description: Request statistics for the McpHelloWorld app
